title: Airwallex solutions cards
description: A centred eyebrow, headline and intro over five tall saturated gradient cards (orange, violet-magenta, blue-purple, teal-blue, magenta-red), each with an icon and bold white title, a short line, an arrow and a product shot peeking up from the bottom edge. Cards rise into place as they scroll into view and lift a touch with a soft shadow on hover. A row of five on desktop, a stack on phones.
notes: card gradients come from the theme's highlight, primary and chart colours (see airwallex-gradient)
the reveal is CSS scroll-driven; browsers without it show the cards in place
